_comment: WASM size budgets in bytes for deployable release contract artifacts (issue #2280). Max absolute Soroban limit is 131072 bytes (128 KiB). stellarlend_lending.wasm currently builds at 231152 bytes, ABOVE the network limit; its budget is a no-growth ratchet (current size + ~1% headroom) until the contract is split/slimmed. Lower it as the contract shrinks; target 129024.
